schema:
CREATE TABLE "vehicle" ("id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "vehicle_class" TEXT, "model_name" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE "incident" ("id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "vehicle_id" INTEGER, "casualties" INTEGER, "damage" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("vehicle_id") REFERENCES "vehicle" ("id"));
correct_query: SELECT "casualties", "damage" FROM (SELECT "LHS"."vehicle_id" AS "vehicle_id", "LHS"."id" AS "id", "LHS"."casualties" AS "casualties", "LHS"."damage" AS "damage", "RHS"."vehicle_class" AS "vehicle_class", "RHS"."model_name" AS "model_name" FROM "incident" AS "LHS" INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM "vehicle" WHERE ("vehicle_class" = 'truck')) AS RHS ON (LHS.vehicle_id = RHS.id)) ORDER BY casualties, "casualties" NULLS LAST, "damage" NULLS LAST
